column2: hi naḥ sutam madhoḥ dhārābhiḥ ajyase indra tvādātam it yaśaḥ abhi dyumnāni
sva hi andhasaḥ rādhase tanvā mahe na stotāram nide karaḥ vayam indra tvāyavaḥ
mahe ukthebhiḥ kuvit āgamat tān dadhiṣva śatakrato iti śatakrato jaṭhare
ṇīḥ ā aryaḥ āśiṣaḥ upa naḥ haribhyām imāḥ hi tvā matayaḥ stomataṣṭāḥ
jānāḥ arvāk indra sadhamādaḥ vahantu pra ye dvitā divaḥ ṛñjanti ātāḥ susammṛṣṭāsaḥ
ṣā viśvam ā bhāti rocanam hariaśvaḥ haritam dhatte āyudham ā vajram bāhvoḥ harim
na pratijānate vṛkṣam pakvam phalam aṅkīiva dhūnuhi indra sampāraṇam vasu svayuḥ
pṛthivyāḥ pra uroḥ mahaḥ antarikṣāt ṛjīṣī urum gabhīram januṣā abhi
apa mṛdhaḥ nudasva atha abhayam kṛṇuhi viśvataḥ naḥ uta ṛtubhiḥ ṛtupāḥ
ba pratikāmam yathā te rasaāśiraḥ prathamam somyasya yat jāyathāḥ tat
yam sukratum dhiṣaṇe iti vibhvataṣṭam ghanam vṛtrāṇām janayanta devāḥ yam nu nakiḥ
vṛṣabhaḥ marutvān ā uruvyacāḥ pṛṇatām ebhiḥ annaiḥ ā asya haviḥ tanvaḥ
yanti viśvataḥ vājasanim pūḥbhidam tūrṇim apturam dhāmasācam abhisācam
bhyam satrā dadhire harivaḥ juṣasva bodhi āpiḥ avasaḥ nūtanasya sakhe
ojasā sutam rādhānām pate piba tu asya girvaṇaḥ yaḥ te anu svadhām asat
arthaḥ vṛṣayamāṇaḥ upa gīḥbhiḥ īṭe tṛtīye dhānāḥ savane purustuta
gīḥbhiḥ iḷayā madantā tiṣṭha su kam maghavan mā parā gāḥ somasya nu
mocanam vājinaḥ rāsabhasya apāḥ somam astam indra pra yāhi kalyāṇīḥ
adribhiḥ madantaḥ gīḥbhiḥ adhvare sute sacā devebhiḥ viprāḥ ṛṣayaḥ nṛcakṣasaḥ
randhaya naḥ sasarparīḥ amatim bādhamānā bṛhat mimāya jamadagnidattā ā
sāram ojaḥ dhehi spandane śiṃśapāyām akṣa vīḷo iti vīḷita vīḷayasva mā
hāsayanti na gardabham puraḥ aśvāt nayanti ime indra bharatasya putrāḥ apapitvam
pūrvyāḥ āvividre ṛtavarī iti ṛtavarī rodasī iti satyavācaḥ naraḥ cit vām
bruvāte iti mithunāni nāma viśvā it ete iti janima sam viviktaḥ mahaḥ devān
asmabhyam ā suva sarvatātim sukṛt supāṇiḥ svavān ṛtavā devaḥ
hitvā puramdaraḥ vṛtrahā dhṛṣṇusenaḥ samgṛbhya naḥ ā bhara bhūri paśvaḥ
dyauḥ uta āpaḥ sūryaḥ nakṣatraiḥ uru antarikṣam śṛṇvantu naḥ vṛṣaṇaḥ parvatāsaḥ
goḥ vratā devānām upa nu prabhūṣan mahat devānām asuratvam ekam
tā abandhanaḥ carati vatsaḥ ekaḥ mitrasya tā varuṇasya vratāni
pūṃṣi tayoḥ anyat rocate kṛṣṇam anyat śyāvī ca yat aruṣī ca
nyat sadhrīcīnā pathyā sā viṣūcī ā dhenavaḥ dhunayantām
samīcī ubhe iti te iti asya vasunā nyṛṣṭe iti niṛṣṭe śṛṇve vīraḥ
manuṣyāny eva āntrāṇi śunaḥ śyenarūpeṇa indro vṛtyartham āharan madhu yasya sa vāmadevo

column2: śvarūpaḥ uta triudhā purudhā prajāvān trianīkaḥ patyate māhinavān saḥ
āpaḥ cit asya rodasī iti cit urvī iti ratnam bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya
putram dhenavaḥ vāvaśānāḥ mahaḥ caranti bibhratam vapūṃṣi accha vivakmi rodasī iti
dakṣiṇāyāḥ ā dyotanim vahati śubhrayāmā uṣasaḥ stomaḥ aśvinau ajīgaḥ iti
madema saha nu samānāḥ aśvinā vāyunā yuvam sudakṣā niyutbhiḥ ca sajoṣasā
ghṛtavat juhota pra saḥ mitra martaḥ astu prayasvān yaḥ te āditya śikṣati
traśravaḥtamam abhi yaḥ mahinā divam mitraḥ babhūva saprathāḥ abhi śravaḥbhiḥ
śa indrasya sakhyam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśuḥ manoḥ napātaḥ apasaḥ dadhanvire
ṇi yemire vratā devānām manuṣaḥ ca dharmabhiḥ indra ṛbhubhiḥ vājibhiḥ vājayan
nā cakramiva navyasi ā vavṛtsva ava syūmaiva cinvatī maghonī uṣāḥ yāti
candrāiva bhānum vi dadhe purutrā imāḥ ūm iti vām bhṛmayaḥ manyamānāḥ
ojaḥ ā cake vṛṣabham carṣaṇīnām viśvarūpam adābhyam bṛhaspatim vareṇyam iyam te
niḥkṛtam ṛtasya yonim āsadam somaḥ asmabhyam dvipade catuḥpade ca paśave
erire amartyam yajata martyeṣu ā devam ādevam janata pracetasam viśvam ādevam
mugdhi asmat saḥ tvam naḥ agne avamaḥ bhava ūtī nediṣṭhaḥ asyāḥ uṣasaḥ
cetayat manuṣaḥ yajñabandhuḥ pra tam mahyā raśanayā nayanti saḥ kṣeti asya duryāsu
taraḥ manuṣyāḥ abhi pra seduḥ ṛtam āśuṣāṇāḥ aśmavrajāḥ sudughāḥ vavre
rocata dyauḥ ut divyāḥ uṣasaḥ bhānuḥ arta ā sūryaḥ bṛhataḥ tiṣṭhat ajrān
devaḥ deveṣu aratiḥ nidhāyi hotā yajiṣṭhaḥ mahnā śucadhyai havyaiḥ agniḥ manuṣaḥ
gne avimān aśvī yajñaḥ nṛvatsakhā sadam it apramṛṣyaḥ iḷāvān eṣaḥ
mṛtāya dāśāt duvaḥ tve iti kṛṇavate yatasruk na saḥ rāyā śaśamānaḥ vi
vāghate sutasomāya vidhate yaviṣṭha ratnam bhara śaśamānāya ghṛṣve pṛthu
taḥ śucantaḥ agnim vavṛdhantaḥ indram ūrvam gavyam parisadantaḥ agman ā yūthāiva
tnoḥ acittāt hiraṇyarūpam avase kṛṇudhvam ayam yoniḥ cakṛma yam vayam te
t aryamṇe kat bhagāya kat dhiṣṇyāsu vṛdhasānaḥ
sinā eṣā jāmaryeṇa payasā pīpāya ṛtena hi sma vṛṣabhaḥ cit aktaḥ
āpeḥ mā bhrātuḥ agne anṛjoḥ ṛṇam veḥ mā sakhyuḥ dakṣam ripoḥ bhujema
vān ibhena tṛṣvīm anu prasitim drūṇānaḥ astā asi vidhya rakṣasaḥ tapiṣṭhaiḥ
kṛṇuṣva daivyāni agne ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnām jāmim ajāmim pra mṛṇīhi
dyūn iha tvā bhūri ā caret upa tman doṣāvastaḥ dīdivāṃsam anu dyūn
pāyavaḥ sadhryañcaḥ nisadya agne tava naḥ pāntu amūra
vaiśvānarāya vaiśvānarīyam ūrdhva ekādaśāyam ihādo jagatī pañcānuṣṭubho

column2: sā amanuta guhyam cāru pṛśneḥ mātuḥ pade parame anti sat goḥ vṛṣṇaḥ
reṇa vacasā phalgvena pratītyena kṛdhunā atṛpāsaḥ adha te agne kim iha vadanti
dakṣiṇit devatātim urāṇaḥ ut ūm iti svaruḥ navajāḥ na akraḥ paśvaḥ anakti
avāri na mātarā pitarā nu cit iṣṭau adha mitraḥ na sudhitaḥ pāvakaḥ agniḥ
vi ūm iti dhāḥ hotāram agnim manuṣaḥ ni seduḥ namasyantaḥ uśijaḥ śaṃsam āyoḥ
yajiṣṭham sapta dhāmabhiḥ tam śaśvatīṣu mātṛṣu vane ā vītam aśritam
asya vātaḥ anuvāti śociḥ vṛṇakti tigmām ataseṣu jihvām sthirā cit annā
ṣyantaḥ indhate te rāyā te suvīryaiḥ sasavāṃsaḥ vi śṛṇvire ye agnā dadhire duvaḥ
nām havyā ca mānuṣāṇām veṣi it ūm iti asya dūtyam yasya jujoṣaḥ adhvaram
divaḥ na stanayanti śuṣmāḥ tava svādiṣṭhā agne samdṛṣṭiḥ idā cit ahnaḥ idā
hi agne gṛṇate manīṣām kham vepasā tuvijāta stavānaḥ viśvebhiḥ yat vavanaḥ
tim āre aṃhaḥ āre viśvām duḥmatim yat nipāsi doṣā śivaḥ sahasaḥ sūno iti
vān yat cit hi te puruṣatrā yaviṣṭha acittibhiḥ cakṛma kat cit āgaḥ
ryaḥ jyotiṣā devaḥ eti ūrdhvam bhānum savitā devaḥ aśret drapsam davidhvat goiṣaḥ
ti nākam jātavedāḥ akhyat devaḥ rocamānāḥ
yate devaḥ deveṣu yajñiyaḥ pari triviṣṭi adhvaram yāti agniḥ rathīḥiva ā
ṣaḥ vām devau aśvinā kumāraḥ sāhadevyaḥ dīrghaāyuḥ astu somakaḥ tam yuvam devau
vedi sudṛśīkam arkaiḥ mahi jyotiḥ rurucuḥ yat ha vastoḥ andhā tamāṃsi
patiḥ bhavan śavasā śūra dhṛṣṇo iti apaḥ yat adrim puruhūta dardaḥ āviḥ
śānaḥ ṛjrā vājam na gadhyam yuyūṣan kaviḥ yat ahan pāryāya bhūṣāt kutsāya
dṛśīiva puṣṭiḥ tam it vaḥ indram suhavam huvema yaḥ tā
madema śaradaḥ ca pūrvīḥ eva it indrāya vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe brahma akarma bhṛgavaḥ
bhinat girim śavasā vajram iṣṇan āviḥkṛṇvānaḥ sahasānaḥ ojaḥ vadhīt
mānaḥ ame viśvāḥ adhithāḥ indra kṛṣṭīḥ
gāḥ ajayat sam hiraṇyā sam aśviyā maghavā yaḥ ha pūrvīḥ ebhiḥ nṛbhiḥ nṛtamaḥ
gavyantaḥ indram sakhyāya viprāḥ aśvayantaḥ vṛṣaṇam

column2: vṛtrahatye ava asṛjanta jivrayaḥ na devāḥ bhuvaḥ samrāṭ indra satyayoniḥ
avanim viśvadhenām turvītaye vayyāya kṣarantīm aramayaḥ namasā ejat arṇaḥ
ṇāni vipra āvidvān āha viduṣe karāṃsi yathāyathā vṛṣṇyāni svagūrtā
uśan ūm iti su naḥ sumanāḥ upāke somasya nu susutasya svadhāvaḥ pāḥ
ta vrajam apavartā asi gonām śikṣānaraḥ samitheṣu prahāvān vasvaḥ rāśim abhinetā
tuvirādhasaḥ nṝn yasya kratuḥ vidathyaḥ na samrāṭ sahvān tarutraḥ abhi
n sadantaḥ adrim auśijasya gohe ā duroṣāḥ pāstyasya hotā yaḥ naḥ mahān
samrāṭ hantā vṛtram varivaḥ pūrave karitikaḥ purustuta kratvā naḥ śagdhi rāyaḥ
viśvā rodhāṃsi pravataḥ ca pūrvīḥ dyauḥ ṛṣvāt janiman rejata kṣāḥ ā mātarā
tim syandayadhyai pipīḷe aṃśuḥ madyaḥ na sindhuḥ ā tvā śamī śaśamānasya śaktiḥ
uśānaḥ juṣamāṇaḥ andhaḥ vavakṣe ṛṣvaḥ śucate dhanāya kaḥ asya vīraḥ sadhamā
ṣa kathā kat asya sakhyam sakhibhyaḥ ye asmin kāmam suyujam tatasre
candrā vapuṣe vapūṃṣi ṛtena dīrgham iṣaṇanta pṛkṣaḥ ṛtena gāvaḥ ṛtam ā viveśuḥ
tam it naraḥ vi hvayante samīke ririkvāṃsaḥ tanvaḥ kṛṇvata trām mithaḥ yat
venam tam it sakhāyam kṛṇute samatsu yaḥ indrāya sunavat somam adya pacāt
kaḥ adya naryaḥ devakāmaḥ uśan indrasya sakhyam jujoṣa kaḥ vā

column2: jānaḥ pathā uruṇā manaḥjavāḥ asarji tūyam yayau madhunā somyena uta śravaḥ
apa joṣam jabhāra abhi īm āsa tvakṣasā vīryeṇa īrmā puramdhiḥ ajahāt
śūraḥ madāya prati dhat pibadhyai tvā yujā tava tat
praśastāḥ abādhethām amṛṇatam ni śatrūn avindethām apacitim vadhatraiḥ
ṇā vājayadhyai juṣṭām anu pra diśam mandayadhyai utvavṛṣāṇaḥ rādhase tuviṣmān
na it anā tvā devāsaḥ indra yuyudhuḥ yat ahā naktam ā atiraḥ
indra sampiṇak apa uṣāḥ anasaḥ sarat sampiṣṭāt aha bibhyuṣī ni yat sīm
ta tyā turvaśāyadū iti asnātārā śacīpatiḥ indraḥ vidvān apārayat uta tyā
vāmam pūṣā vāmam bhagaḥ vāmam devaḥ karūḷatī kayā naḥ citraḥ
dhayum uta sma sadyaḥ it pari śaśamānāya sunvate puru cit maṃhase vasu
īyate asmākam uttamam kṛdhi śravaḥ deveṣu sūrya varṣiṣṭham dyāmiva upari
mataḥ yujaḥ vājāya ghṛṣvaye tvam hi ekaḥ īśiṣe indra vājasya gomataḥ saḥ
mahe arvācīnaḥ vaso iti bhava asme iti su matsva andhasaḥ somānām indra
trā śūra vṛtrahan ā naḥ bhajasva rādhasi pra te babhrū iti vicakṣaṇā
oṃ pra ṛbhubhya ekādaśārbhavaṃ vā ṛbhurvibhvehopanavān aśvo 'ntyā triṣṭub

column2: sutasya pītiḥ sukṛtyayā yat suapasyayā ca ekam vicakra camasam catuḥdhā
vājāsaḥ savanam madāya tasmai rayim ṛbhavaḥ sarvavīram ā takṣata vṛṣaṇaḥ mandasānāḥ
tat vaḥ divyasya pravācanam dyām ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivīm yat ca puṣyatha
yam devāsaḥ avatha saḥ vicarṣaṇiḥ saḥ vājī arvā saḥ
nyān tam vājam citram ṛbhavaḥ dada naḥ upa naḥ vājāḥ
nu vaḥ ceti agriyam madāya ṛbhum ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ rayim vāje vājintamam yujam indrasvantam
bhibhūtim ugram uta vājinam puruniḥsidhvānam dadhikrām ūm iti dadathuḥ viśva
paśumat ca yūtham uta sma ā su prathamaḥ sariṣyan
